name: Wardman Park Redevelopment
desc: CFS provided full façade fabrication services for the redevelopment of Wardman Park, delivering all aluminum composite material (ACM) cladding, aluminum flashing, and coping systems for this large-scale, highly coordinated project. All ACM panels were produced in fully custom finishes, including Medium Gray, Bistro Bronze, Douglas Fir Green, Vintage Graphite, Dark Bronze, Sunstorm Champagne Bronze, Anodic Satin Mica, Duranar Sunstorm Cashmere Pearl, and Pearl Gold . All aluminum flashing and coping were fabricated from 0.080" aluminum and finished to match the custom ACM color palette, ensuring consistency across the entire building envelope. This project highlights CFS’s capability to manage complex façade scopes requiring precision fabrication, custom finishes, and tight coordination across multiple elevations and building systems.

name: 225 Vine Street Apartments
desc: CFS Designs US provided the rainscreen substructure and Equitone Tectiva fiber cement panels in two stunning colors, TE 85 Graphite and TE 15 Argent Grey, for this beautiful project in Washington DC. This choice exemplifies the perfect combination of aesthetics and functionality, with TE 85 offering a bold and modern touch, and TE 15 providing a touch of classic elegance.

name: Pike and Rose Development
desc: CFS Designs US delivered the for a new development with Cafe Noir Pearl and Driftwood Mica ACM panels, along with the complete rainscreen substructure. Our expertise ensured a stunning facade and flawless function, all on a tight schedule.

name: Cultural DC
desc: In downtown DC, CFS Designs US provided the rainscreen substructure and ACM panels in a beautiful Graphite Mica finish, contributing to the project's modern elegance.

name: GMU - Institute for Digital Innovation
desc: CFS Designs US delivered a stunning full-building façade for the George Mason University – Institute for Digital Innovation. The project featured two custom Alucobond finishes — Sunstorm Pewter and Arcadia Silver with grain — paired with ATAS RigidWall II panels in two additional custom colors. Our scope included the fabrication of intricate architectural eyebrows and full cladding of the sky bridge. This high-profile project showcases CFS’s commitment to precision, innovation, and exceptional design execution.

name: South County Police Station & Animal Shelter
desc: CFS Designs US played a key role in enhancing the facade of a building in Lorton, VA, by supplying and installing silver metallic ACM panels and the underlying rainscreen substructure.

name: Pickersgill Retirement Center
desc: CFS Designs US provided custom fabrication for the Equitone pictura 12mm Fiber Cement Panels featured on this curved entranceway. Our team fabricated the substructure components and concealed fastener system to achieve the architect’s clean, modern design. The result highlights the precision and craftsmanship behind every CFS Designs US project.

name: SOME1515 Apartments
desc: CFS Designs US went above and beyond to create one-of-a-kind eyebrow ACM panels for this Washington, D.C. project. These architectural panels, known for their durability and versatility, were custom fabricated in three eye-catching colors: Sun Yellow, Orange Liqueur, and Red Colorful Leaves. To ensure a flawless fit, CFS Designs US worked closely with the subcontractor throughout the fabrication process, meticulously reviewing shop drawings and conducting multiple site visits. This meticulous collaboration exemplifies CFS Design US’s commitment to quality and customer satisfaction.

name: 255 Commons Drive
desc: CFS Design US played a key role in the flawless execution of this stunning new construction project in West Falls Church, VA. Our expertise in facade solutions came to the forefront as we provided the complete rainscreen substructure and beautiful Equitone Natura fiber cement panels.

name: Toledo Road Apartments
desc: CFS Designs US fabricated the ACM panels for a striking new apartment complex, using Alucobond in three rich shades: Tri-Corn Black, Harvest Gold Moca, and TBL Black. The dark tones complement each other beautifully, creating a sleek, modern façade that truly stands out.

name: Subaru Dealership
desc: CFS Design US’s dedication to detail shone through at the Subaru dealership in Manassas, VA. Our team was tasked with fabricating new ACM panels that flawlessly matched the existing panels on the dealership's facade.

name: Mary Washington Urgent Care at Embrey Mill
desc: CFS Designs US proudly contributed to the Embrey Mill Town Center in Stafford, VA, by providing custom ACM coping panels. These panels, fabricated in a stunning Tri-Black color, cap the building's facade, adding a touch of elegance and definition.

name: Day Report Center
desc: CFS is proud to present this stunning ACM Facade in West Virginia! The Epernay Champagne Metallic finish adds a touch of elegance and sophistication to this beautiful building. CFS helped facilitate an intricate and seamless integration of the window installation and facade panel alignment.

name: Courtyard by Marriott Dulles Airport Chantilly
desc: CFS Designs US fabricated and detailed this sleek courtyard canopy using Alucobond ACM panels in Dusty Charcoal II. The result is a clean, modern finish that enhances the architecture with precision craftsmanship and lasting durability.

name: 7607 Old Georgetown Road
desc: CFS Designs is proud to have played a key role in the fabrication of this intricate soffit system, featuring the bold and modern look of Alucobond ACM in Focus Black II. Our team delivered precision-crafted panels that enhance both the visual depth and architectural sophistication of the project, showcasing our commitment to quality, detail, and innovative design.

name: Private Residence
desc: CFS Design US played a key role in elevating the curb appeal of a stunning home in Great Falls, VA, by providing and installing Easy-Fix ACM panels in two eye-catching colors: Arctic Frost and Graphite Mica. Easy-Fix ACM panels are a popular choice for modern architecture due to their ease of installation and sleek aesthetic.

name: WMATA Station Bladensburg
desc: CFS Designs fabricated and supplied sleek Focus Black II ACM panels for the WMATA Bladensburg Station in Washington, D.C. Our scope included the main building, canopy, and fuel fill-up station, all finished in durable, modern ACM. The result is a clean, cohesive design that highlights precision fabrication and contemporary aesthetics.

name: Choice Neighborhood Condos
desc: CFS is proud to have contributed to the design of the elegant ACM entrances at the Choice Neighborhood Condos in Newport News, Virginia. The pristine Pure White ACM finish adds a touch of sophistication and modernity to the building's exterior.

name: Johns Hopkins University School of Advanced International Studies
desc: CFS Design US played a vital role in enhancing the aesthetics of the newly built Johns Hopkins School of Advanced International Studies with a unique and beautiful interior application. We fabricated Equitone Linea panels specifically designed for adhesive installation, creating a rigid and visually striking feature within the school.

name: LifeBridge Health Northwest Hospital
desc: CFS Designs US provided the rainscreen substructure and EQUITONE Tectiva TE-15 fiber cement panels for the renovation of LifeBridge Health Northwest Hospital in Maryland. The TE-15 finish delivers a refined, natural aesthetic while offering the durability and performance required for a demanding healthcare environment.

name: The Accolade
desc: Right in the heart of Washington, DC—just steps from the White House—CFS Designs US provided shop fabrication of the subframing and Alucobond® ACM panels for The Accolade renovation, featuring a custom Roman Bronze Mica finish. The package was detailed and fabricated to support a refined, high-impact exterior upgrade in a prominent urban setting.

name: Tidewater Community College
desc: CFS Designs US fabricated the subframing and ALPOLIC® ACM panels for the entrance sign at Tidewater Community College. The sign features SMX Metallic Silver and MRO Anthracite Grey, delivering a clean, contemporary look with durability suited for a high-visibility campus gateway.

name: Oven Addition - Integer 1
desc: CFS Designs US fabricated the subframing and Alucobond® ACM panel system for the Integer 1 – Oven Addition, delivering a clean, modern exterior with a three-tone palette: Pure White, Platinum Mica, and Dusty Charcoal. The combination of precision-fabricated support and durable ACM cladding provides crisp lines, long-term performance, and a refined finish for this facility expansion.

name: Flavor Hive
desc: CFS Designs US was proud to help bring the flagship Flavor Hive store to life with sleek Alucobond® Focus Black II ACM panels, delivering a clean, modern finish that highlights the brand’s bold identity.

name: Gensler Offices
desc: CFS Design US played a part in creating a sophisticated outdoor space for the world-renowned architecture firm Gensler's Washington D.C. offices. We supplied and fabricated custom ACM panels in a classic Focus Black II color for their patio.

name: General Services Admin Building
desc: CFS Design US was a key contributor to the modernization of a GSA building in Baltimore, Maryland, providing Oyster-colored ACM panels and rainscreen substructure for the entire project.

name: WETA HQ
desc: CFS Designs delivered a complete solution for the WETA HQ soffit, crafting custom Moondust Mica ACM panels and handling the substructure for a cohesive and visually striking exterior.

name: 20 Massachuset Ave Apartments
desc: CFS Design US gave this Washington, D.C. apartment a modern makeover with Sunstorm Bronze ACM panels, crafting the entire coping and rainscreen system for a cohesive, functional upgrade.

name: Delaware State University - Early Childhood Innovation Center
desc: CFS Designs US proudly fabricated and delivered these stunning fiber cement panels with precision-installed color-matched rivets for the Delaware State University – Early Childhood Innovation Center in Dover, DE. The clean lines and cohesive finish reflect our commitment to quality, craftsmanship, and seamless architectural integration.

name: Kisco Senior Living Community
desc: CFS Designs US utilized Focus Black II Alucobond ACM to bring a sleek, modern touch to the canopies at Kisco Senior Living Community in Gaithersburg, MD. The bold finish adds both style and durability, enhancing the entranceways with a refined architectural presence.

name: Inova Hospital - Woodbridge
desc: CFS Designs US fabricated the subframing and ALFREX® ACM panels for two entrance canopies at INOVA Hospital in Woodbridge, Virginia. The design features QBB Teak soffits paired with Anodic Clear Mica canopy finishes, creating a clean, modern appearance that balances warmth, durability, and performance for a high-traffic healthcare environment.

name: CitiBank - Bethesda
desc: For the CitiBank project in Bethesda, Maryland, CFS Designs US shop-fabricated the rainscreen subframing and Equitone® pictura fiber cement panels in PW141. This façade package delivers a sharp, polished appearance with dependable exterior performance and carefully coordinated panel detailing.

name: Deloitte University - Project Star
desc: CFS worked closely with the project team to deliver a striking exterior façade and soffit package for the addition at Deloitte University – Project Star Building NW1 in Westlake, Texas. This project features custom-colored ALUCOBOND® ACM panels in Classic Bronze, Sunstorm Dark Bronze, and Proper Pewter The combination of clean architectural lines, expansive glazing, warm metallic finishes, and detailed soffit work helped create a modern and inviting environment that blends beautifully with the surrounding landscape.

name: TCAT Chattanooga
desc: CFS provided ACM panel fabrication and subframing for the TCAT Chattanooga Transportation and Logistics Truck Driver Training Facility in Soddy Daisy, Tennessee. The building's exterior features ALUCOBOND Champagne Metallic panels, delivering a clean, modern finish for this state-of-the-art training facility.

name: Armstrong Bank - Rose Creek
desc: CFS provided ACM panel fabrication, subframing, flashing, and canopy work for the Armstrong Bank Rose Creek project. The building's exterior features a Statuary Bronze finish with matching flashing, and the canopy adds a striking finishing touch to the facility's overall design.

name: Tidelock Condos
desc: CFS Designs US provided ACM panel fabrication and subframing for the Tidelock Condos, delivering a clean, modern finish for this residential development. This project highlights CFS’s ability to deliver fabrication and subconstruction together, ensuring quality and consistency from the shop to the jobsite.

name: Tidelock Rental/Retail
desc: CFS Designs US provided ACM panel fabrication and subframing for the Tidelock Condos, delivering a clean, modern finish for this residential development.

name: Edgewood
desc: CFS Designs US provided ACM panel fabrication and subframing for Edgewood, pairing light and charcoal panels with brick for a crisp, contemporary façade.

name: 400 Belgrade
desc: CFS Designs US provided ALPOLIC ACM panel fabrication and subframing for 400 Belgrade. The façade combines RVW White panels with accents in a warm Rio Aleon wood-look finish, and the rivets were painted to match for a clean, seamless appearance.

name: 7-Eleven PG Plaza
desc: CFS Designs US provided Alucobond Plus ACM panel fabrication for the 7-Eleven PG Plaza. The façade features PVDF-2 finishes in Anodic Satin Mica and Cadet Gray, giving this retail building a clean, durable, and modern look.

name: 1265 Main Street
desc: CFS Designs US provided Alucobond Plus ACM panel fabrication for 1265 Main Street. The smooth, dark panels complement the building’s vertical ribbed metal siding, giving this commercial project a clean, modern look with sharp, defined lines.

name: 1200 Bladensburg
desc: CFS Designs US fabricated the Alucobond Plus ACM panels for 1200 Bladensburg, a four-story mixed-use building in Northeast Washington, DC. The dark panel facade is set off by bold red window surrounds, creating a striking contrast above the glass storefront at street level and giving the corner a crisp, contemporary presence.
